name: UdanAir
tagline: An airline where a noon fare sale and a foggy morning both bring everyone at once
summary: UdanAir flies 900 flights a day and sells 1.6 lakh seats online: fare search, booking, seats, payments, web check-in and boarding passes, all fed by the GDS that holds the flights. A fare sale at noon brings twenty times the usual traffic; a foggy morning cancels flights and sends every passenger to rebook at once. Fare searches that time out and boarding passes that never arrive keep coming back.

incidents.title: Fare search timed out when the noon sale opened
incidents.desc: At 12:00 searches took over 30 seconds and most returned errors for 25 minutes.
whys: Searches timed out at 12:00
Every search priced every fare bucket from scratch
Fare buckets are computed on every search instead of precomputed
incidents.fix: Shortened the sale page and added servers.
incidents.lesson: A sale is a read storm on fares.

incidents.title: Fare cache expired at once during a sale
incidents.desc: At 12:30 the whole fare cache expired and the fares service fell over for 10 minutes.
whys: The fares service fell over
Every fare entry expired in the same second
The whole fare cache expires at once with no jitter
incidents.lesson: Expiries in step become a stampede.

incidents.title: GDS outage froze booking for 40 minutes
incidents.desc: The GDS connection dropped at 10:30; booking calls waited 30 seconds each and piled up.
whys: Bookings froze
Every call to the GDS waited for its 30-second timeout
There is no circuit breaker or cached availability when the GDS is down
incidents.fix: Waited for the GDS to recover.
incidents.lesson: A slow dependency is worse than a dead one.

incidents.title: Boarding passes failed in the morning rush
incidents.desc: From 05:30 to 06:15 web check-in returned errors at the boarding-pass step.
whys: Boarding passes failed
Each boarding pass PDF was built inside the request
Boarding passes are generated synchronously in the check-in request
incidents.fix: Asked passengers to check in at the airport.

incidents.title: Fog cancellations: SMS blast delayed rebooking links
incidents.desc: 120 flights were cancelled at 06:00; rebooking SMS took 50 minutes to go out.
whys: Rebooking SMS went out late
All disruption messages went out in one blast
Disruption messages are sent in one blast with no priority or queue
incidents.fix: Sent the remaining SMS by hand.
incidents.lesson: The passengers on the first flights need their message first.

incidents.title: Seats held by bots during a sale

debts.title: Precompute fare buckets per route and serve them from a cache
debts.desc: Price every route's buckets when fares change and serve searches from the cache.
debts.cause: Fare buckets are computed on every search instead of precomputed

debts.title: Refresh fares ahead of expiry and serve cached fares
debts.desc: Precompute every fare entry in the background before it expires, with expiry times spread at random, so the whole cache never expires at once.
debts.cause: The whole fare cache expires at once with no jitter

debts.title: Circuit breaker and cached availability when the GDS is down
debts.desc: Trip a circuit breaker after five slow GDS calls and serve cached availability, queueing bookings to confirm later.
debts.cause: There is no circuit breaker or cached availability when the GDS is down

debts.title: Generate boarding passes asynchronously
debts.desc: Confirm check-in at once and deliver the boarding pass PDF from a queue a few seconds later.
debts.cause: Boarding passes are generated synchronously in the check-in request

debts.title: Send disruption messages through a priority queue
debts.desc: Queue disruption SMS with the earliest departures first, and throttle to the provider's limit.
debts.cause: Disruption messages are sent in one blast with no priority or queue

debts.title: Rate-limit unpaid seat holds per account and device
debts.desc: Expire unpaid holds after 10 minutes and allow at most two open holds per account and device.
debts.cause: Unpaid seat holds never expire and are not limited per account

debts.title: Contract tests against the payment gateway sandbox
debts.desc: Run every payment change against the gateway's sandbox in CI before release.
debts.cause: Payment changes are not tested against the gateway sandbox

debts.title: Separate connection pools for sales traffic and revenue reports
debts.desc: Give booking and check-in their own pool and run revenue reports on a replica.
debts.cause: Sales traffic and revenue reports share one connection pool

debts.title: Precompute seat maps per flight and serve them cached
debts.desc: Keep each flight's seat map in a cache updated on every hold and sale.

debts.title: Load test the noon sale at 20x
debts.desc: Rehearse a sale opening at twenty times normal traffic before every sale.

debts.title: Idempotency keys on booking and payment calls
debts.desc: Make retried bookings and payments safe so double clicks never double-charge.

debts.title: Pre-render the sale page and fare calendar at the edge
debts.desc: Serve the sale landing page and fare calendar pre-rendered from the edge for 30 seconds.

debts.title: Use IST for flight cut-off times
debts.desc: Compare web check-in cut-offs in IST.

tour.headline: Every call to the GDS waits 30 seconds when it is down, so one slow dependency freezes booking and check-in; a circuit breaker with cached availability costs 16 hours.
